faq.section_description: Quick answers to common setup, WhatsApp, and plan questions. For the full list, see General FAQ in Docs.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

supported_platforms.question: Which platforms does Akeed support?
supported_platforms.answer: Akeed supports Shopify directly and can be connected to other commerce setups through the available integration flow.

setup_time.question: How long does setup take?
setup_time.answer: Most merchants finish setup in a few minutes and can send a test confirmation right away.

own_whatsapp_number.question: Do I need my own WhatsApp number to start?
own_whatsapp_number.answer: No. Most merchants start with Akeed's shared official infrastructure, then move to their own number later if needed.

official_apis.question: Are messages sent through official WhatsApp APIs?
official_apis.answer: Yes. Akeed uses official Meta WhatsApp APIs for reliable message delivery.

customize_messages.question: Can I customize Akeed's messages and language?
customize_messages.answer: Yes. You can customize the confirmation copy and choose the language style that best fits your brand and customer base.

customer_no_reply.question: What happens if the customer does not reply?
customer_no_reply.answer: The order stays unconfirmed so your team can hold it, follow up, or skip shipping based on your process.

plan_limit.question: What happens when I reach my monthly confirmation limit?
plan_limit.answer: New confirmations pause until your billing cycle renews or you upgrade your plan.

about.intro: Learn about Akeed Digital Solutions, our mission, and how we help e-commerce merchants reduce wasted shipping costs.
about.missionBody: Akeed Digital Solutions builds tools that help e-commerce merchants across the MENA region reduce wasted shipping costs on cash-on-delivery orders. Our flagship product automates order confirmation through official Meta WhatsApp Cloud APIs, helping merchants verify orders before fulfillment and avoid failed delivery attempts.
